Dataset: 1,000 users, 3,000 posts, 9,000 comments (foreign keys users<-posts<-comments).  Token estimate: bytes/4 on both sides.

**Parity check** (same 8 queries on SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL): identical output on all three.

### Per-task cost

| Task | CCP | SQL-MCP careful | SQL-MCP naive | CCP calls | careful / naive calls | saved vs careful | saved vs naive |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Point lookup: one user, 2 fields | 270 B | 283 B | 471 B | 1 | 1 / 1 | 5% | 43% |
| List 100 users, 2 fields | 2,608 B | 3,405 B | 25,259 B | 1 | 1 / 1 | 23% | 90% |
| List 1000 posts, id+title (big body column) | 49,947 B | 57,944 B | 457,635 B | 1 | 1 / 1 | 14% | 89% |
| Filter: one author's post titles | 304 B | 316 B | 1,088 B | 1 | 1 / 1 | 4% | 72% |
| Nested: user -> posts -> comments | 539 B | 699 B | 2,067 B | 1 | 1 / 3 | 23% | 74% |
| Reverse relation: 50 posts with author name | 3,660 B | 3,654 B | 35,668 B | 1 | 1 / 2 | -0% | 90% |
| Three independent lookups | 1,109 B | 1,571 B | 2,640 B | 1 | 3 / 3 | 29% | 58% |

### A whole agent session

Setup + 5 questions (point lookup, filter, nested 2-level, reverse relation, 3 batched lookups).

| | Bytes | ~Tokens | Round trips | Input cost per 1,000 sessions (@$3/M tokens) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **CCP** | 7,326 | 1,832 | 7 | $5.50 |
| SQL-MCP careful | 9,330 | 2,333 | 12 | $7.00 |
| SQL-MCP naive | 44,741 | 11,186 | 15 | $33.56 |

Saved: **21%** vs careful, **84%** vs naive (501 / 9,354 tokens per session).
